'''Paril Ritta''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[Rebel pilot]] from [[Generis]] who served in the [[Galactic Civil War]]. He was one of four [[BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber]] [[pilot]]s transferred from the [[Atrivis sector]] to bolster the ''[[Profundity]]''{{'s}} [[starfighter]] forces. He later served as [[Blue Twelve]] in the [[Battle of Scarif]] in [[1 BBY]].<ref name="SWROUVG" />
